This generation delivers comprehensive upgrades across the board: superior text understanding & generation, deeper visual perception & reasoning, extended context length, enhanced spatial and video dynamics comprehension, and stronger agent interaction capabilities. sources.snippet: As for "heretic support" it is easy to add heretic model into the available QWEN 3.5 VL node from registry. It is needed to edit the file with the list of models by adding the " someuser/model-name " element into the array of model name in one or two .py files and add a SYSTEM_PROMPT options.
